archimate:ApplicationComponent.name: Knowledge Base Engine
archimate:ApplicationComponent.documentation:
A Knowledge Base Engine is a centralized, searchable repository software component that indexes, stores, and retrieves clinical guidelines, medical literature, institutional policies, and decision-support rules.
Its purpose is to provide immediate access to validated, up-to-date medical and administrative expertise, ensuring that care teams can quickly reference accurate information to make safe, evidence-based clinical decisions.
Example: A clinician typing "sepsis protocol" into an electronic health record system uses this engine to instantly retrieve the latest regional guidelines on antibiotic administration timelines and dosage recommendations.
